title: Risk Adequacy and Anti-Discrimination in Insurance Pricing: Classification, Aggregation, and Transfers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Insurance tariffs must reconcile risk-based pricing, portfolio coverage, and anti-discrimination requirements. We introduce a framework in which tariffs are constructed through classification, aggregation of benchmark risk prices within classes, and balanced transfers, and are evaluated by several distinct criteria. This yields a multi-objective tariff-design problem whose attainable objective set and Pareto frontier describe the resulting trade-offs.   Risk adequacy is measured by the discrepancy between charged premiums and individual benchmark risk prices. Portfolio coverage is assessed through the capital required to make aggregate claims net of premium income acceptable. Anti-discrimination is examined through differences in protected-group composition across tariff classes and through premium effects experienced by protected groups. translated_title: 保险定价中的风险充足性与反歧视：分类、聚合与转移
translated_abstract: 保险费率必须在基于风险的定价、业务组合覆盖与反歧视要求之间取得平衡。我们提出了一个框架，其中费率通过分类、类别内基准风险价格的聚合以及平衡转移来构建，并通过若干不同的标准进行评估。这产生了一个多目标费率设计问题，其可实现的目标集与帕累托前沿刻画了由此产生的各种权衡。风险充足性通过所收取保费与个体基准风险价格之间的差异来衡量。业务组合覆盖通过使扣除保费收入后的总索赔达到可接受水平所需的资本来评估。反歧视则通过各费率类别中受保护群体构成的差异以及受保护群体所经历的保费影响来考察。我们分析了这些标准之间的权衡，并证明了刻画其关系的数学结果。
tldr: 提出一个通过分类、基准风险价格聚合与平衡转移构建保险费率的框架，将风险充足性、业务组合覆盖与反歧视要求统一为多目标费率设计问题，并以帕累托前沿刻画了各目标间的数学权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tariff-design framework based on classification, aggregation of benchmark risk prices, and balanced transfers, unifying risk adequacy, portfolio coverage, and anti-discrimination into a multi-objective optimization problem and mathematically characterizing their Pareto trade-offs.
